commit.message:
fix(profiling): Retry post profile to vroom (#39724)

We were explicitly opting out of retrying any `ReadTimeoutError`. This
is because when the endpoint queries snuba, retrying `ReadTimeoutError`
will just put unnecessary load on snuba as it will timeout again. This
is not the case when inserting the profile to vroom because the timeout
there is *most likely* because of GCS flakes. We should retry this or
the profile will be dropped.
